rows.label: qst610501_msg0001
rows.name: Troubling... Why is he always...

rows.label: qst610501_msg0002
rows.name: My head... My stomach hurts...

rows.label: qst610501_msg0003
rows.name:
If only I could consult Special
Commissioner-dono...
先頭キャラがメレフ

rows.label: qst610501_msg0101
rows.name:
Special Commissioner-dono! I know it's
presumptuous, but I have a request.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0102
rows.name: Commander Mehmed. What is it?

rows.label: qst610501_msg0103
rows.name:
A man in my 12th Company risks his
life defending the imperial capital,
Alba Margen.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0104
rows.name: That's commendable.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0105
rows.name: However...

rows.label: qst610501_msg0106
rows.name:
That's right. The 12th Company's
mission is not defense of the capital.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0107
rows.name:
It is to monitor the Divine Beast
weapons in Temperantia.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0108
rows.name:
But that problem soldier says he'll
protect the city and won't budge from
Bazuain Watchtower.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0109
rows.name:
And he's highly skilled. Even when we
approach to persuade him, he drives us
off...

rows.label: qst610501_msg0110
rows.name:
So I ask that Special Commissioner
Meleph-dono go there and personally
give him his orders.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0111
rows.name: I see...

rows.label: qst610501_msg0112
rows.name:
Normally this would warrant a
court-martial, but all right.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0113
rows.name:
I also want to see the promising young
soldier Commander Mehmed is concerned
about.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0114
rows.name:
And I'm curious how skilled he really
is.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0115
rows.name: Thank you very much.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0116
rows.name:
Like I said, you'll find him
over at Bazuain Watchtower.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0117
rows.name:
Even if he attacks Meleph-sama, please
teach him a lesson.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0118
rows.name: I leave it in your hands.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0119
rows.name: クエスト受注中

rows.label: qst610501_msg0201
rows.name:
Ishaq is staying at Bazuain
Watchtower.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0202
rows.name:
If he attacks, please teach him a
lesson.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0203
rows.name: I leave it in your hands.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0123
rows.name: イスハクを倒した後

rows.label: qst610501_msg0124
rows.name: 帰還

rows.label: qst610501_msg0301
rows.name: Oh... How was Ishaq?

rows.label: qst610501_msg0126
rows.name: 説明

rows.label: qst610501_msg0302
rows.name: Well, that's a relief to hear.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0303
rows.name:
As expected of Special Commissioner
Meleph and the party.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0304
rows.name:
Now I can join the garrison in
Temperantia.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0130
rows.name: 終了1

rows.label: qst610501_msg0305
rows.name:
I have another request: could you look
after Ishaq once more?

rows.label: qst610501_msg0306
rows.name:
I'm worried he might make another
mistake in Temperantia.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0307
rows.name:
His skill is tremendous, but he tends
to jump to conclusions.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0134
rows.name: 受注1

rows.label: qst610501_msg0308
rows.name:
You should find Ishaq guarding
the Divine Beast Weapon Dig
Site in Temperantia.

rows.label: qst610501_msg0309
rows.name: I leave it in your hands.
